question: Does correct anatomical pairing improve prediction relative to one equally sparse incorrect-routing rule with matched available local access?

algorithm: Start query_to_key as the four-index identity permutation in anatomical_order.
Partition indices by the pair (image_query_presence[i], radiomics_presence[i]); use the actual binary masks entering local fusion.
Within each class, sort indices by anatomical_order. For a class of size at least two, send each query to the next class member, wrapping the last to the first.
For a singleton class keep its identity edge and label it identity_fallback. Do not remove the patient or query.
Each regional query receives exactly one nominal radiomics edge. A key keeps its true region identity and source-specific projection; only the query-to-key Boolean routing entry changes.
AND this routing with the unchanged context availability mask. Preserve the existing image-query output gating and all non-radiomics routing entries.
invariants: The four query-to-key assignments form a bijection, so nominal incoming degree remains one for every radiomics key.
For every query i, radiomics_presence[assignment[i]] equals radiomics_presence[i], including unavailable image queries.
The number of incoming edges from available image queries to every radiomics key is preserved because image_query_presence[assignment[i]] equals image_query_presence[i].
Available self-image and clinical-context counts are unchanged for every query; global and shape/spatial local contexts and the global fusion stage are unchanged.
Features, missingness/state codes, anatomical/source embeddings, region identifiers, per-key projections and token order are unchanged.
No new parameter, RNG draw, learned gate, dropout or feature transformation is introduced.
routing.effective_mismatch: image_presence[i] and radiomics_presence[i] and assignment[i] != i
routing.identity_fallback: A class of size one has no valid incorrect assignment under the specified bijection and access constraints; keep its original edge.
routing.no_effective_mismatch: Retain the patient in all training and evaluation inventories; report coverage. Changes among masked unavailable keys are not counted as effective mismatch.
routing.unseen_availability_pattern: Apply the identical algorithm to any of the 256 binary image/radiomics pattern pairs without selection or retuning.

experiment.source_compatibility: Future intervention implementation must prove bitwise unchanged F3 control execution and identical parameter/RNG construction. If it changes comparator behavior, reuse is invalid and a separately reviewed plan revision is required.

analysis.coverage_reporting: all_cases_and_each_split: joint_availability_strata, effective_mismatched_edges, active_identity_fallback_edges, and patients_with_or_without_effective_mismatch; report without outcome-dependent selection
analysis.principal_analysis_unchanged: F3_minus_F2 mean paired IBS over210to730days; worthwhile reduction0.005; this control cannot replace or rescue the principal result

qualification_before_fit: Implement the exact rule under a new explicit intervention identifier; do not overload existing F3 checkpoints or exports.
Exhaust all 256 fabricated image/radiomics availability pairs against actual local-context masks and verify row degree, available access and per-key incoming active-query exposure.
Check same-seed initialized parameter/state shapes and values, counts and RNG state against unchanged F3; no extra trainable parameters or random draws.
Check only declared local radiomics routing entries change; inspect returned local context names/masks and habitat outputs before global fusion.

With fixed weights and a fabricated input, perturb a locally blocked radiomics key and verify that query's local output is unchanged; do not require final-risk invariance because other local paths and global mixing remain available.
Verify singleton fallback produces the same effective local mask as F3; preserve all patient IDs, region identities, true feature values and projection ownership.
Verify batched versus individual computation, train/eval consistency and independence from outcomes, patient ID and training seed.
Bind this design, source, actual per-patient mask coverage and core protocol to the model contract and prediction artifacts; qualification must reject undeclared mask differences.
Complete source-bound same-image full-path numerical qualification on the approved one-H100 workflow before any new cohort fit; failed qualification releases no fits.

feasibility.selected_rule_reason: A single global partial swap leaves PT-intra and LN-intra matched. The specified conditional rule maximizes nonidentity assignments within fixed joint-availability classes, without changing usable access or eligibility.

design_limits: This is one fixed conditional routing intervention, not a sample from all incorrect anatomies.
Equal edge count and available access do not imply equal biological or predictive information content.
Singleton fallback cases remain in the full-cohort estimand and dilute direct routing exposure; their fitted risks may still differ because training changes shared weights.
The result cannot isolate all contributions of anatomy, missingness, feature content or optimization and does not establish clinical validity.
No contour perturbation recipe or additional fit is authorized here.
